# ============================================================================
# RHAT VISUALIZATION FOR PARAM RECOVERY FULL
# ============================================================================
# just checking the distribution of rhats for all parameters in the param
# recovery "full" simulation
# ============================================================================

```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr, gridExtra)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PATHS
# ---------------------------
root_path <- "~/IGT_LLM_DecisionMaking"
results_dir <- file.path(root_path, "src/3_simulation/recovery/results") 

#where the rhats are
param_file <- file.path(results_dir, "param_recovery_group_WSLS_incremental.csv")
df <- read.csv(param_file)
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PREPARING DF
# ---------------------------
# Extract Rhat columns
rhat_cols <- grep("^Rhat_", names(df), value = TRUE)
rhat_data <- df[, c("group_id", "max_rhat", rhat_cols)]

# Reshape to long format
rhat_long <- rhat_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Rhat_"),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "rhat"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = gsub("Rhat_", "", parameter),
    param_type = case_when(
      grepl("^mu_", parameter) ~ "Group Mean (μ)",
      grepl("^lambda_", parameter) ~ "Group SD (λ)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    converged = rhat < 1.1
  )
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# PLOT 1: RHAT DISTRIBUTION BY PARAMETER
# ---------------------------
p1 <- ggplot(rhat_long, aes(x = parameter, y = rhat)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = param_type)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Rhat Distribution by Parameter",
    subtitle = "1.1 (acceptable), 1.01 (ideal)",
    x = "Parameter",
    y = "Rhat",
    fill = "Parameter Type"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p1

ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "rhat_distribution_by_parameter_WSLS.png"),
       plot = p1, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== RHAT SUMMARY BY PARAMETER ===\n")
rhat_by_param <- rhat_long %>%
  group_by(parameter, param_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_groups = n(),
    mean_rhat = round(mean(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    median_rhat = round(median(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    sd_rhat = round(sd(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    min_rhat = round(min(rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_rhat = round(max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    'n_bad (rhat > 1.1)'= sum(rhat > 1.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    'n_good (rhat < 1.01)' = sum(rhat < 1.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_rhat))

print(rhat_by_param, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== RHAT SUMMARY BY PARAMETER TYPE ===\n")
rhat_by_type <- rhat_long %>%
  group_by(param_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_rhat = round(mean(rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_rhat = round(median(rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    '%bad  (rhat > 1.1)'  = paste0(
      round(100 * mean(rhat > 1.1, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%"
    ),
    '%good (rhat < 1.01)' = paste0(
      round(100 * mean(rhat < 1.01, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(rhat_by_type)
```
